claims.object_mention: generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus
claims.quote: Missense mutations in the gene that codes for a neuronal voltage-gated sodium-channel alpha-subunit (SCN1A) were identified in families with generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+).
GEFS+ is a mild type of epilepsy associated with febrile and afebrile seizures.
